landmarks.name: 长城
landmarks.description: 蜿蜒山脊上的世界遗产，适合清晨慢行。
landmarks.description_en: A World Heritage fortification winding across mountain ridges, ideal for an early-morning walk.

landmarks.name: 富士山
landmarks.description: 日本代表性山景，晴天适合远眺与拍照。
landmarks.description_en: Japan’s iconic volcanic peak, best viewed on a clear day from the surrounding lakes.

landmarks.name: 清水寺
landmarks.description: 京都山腰古寺与城市景观的经典组合。
landmarks.description_en: A historic hillside temple with a celebrated wooden stage and wide views across Kyoto.

landmarks.name: 埃菲尔铁塔
landmarks.description: 从塞纳河畔感受巴黎城市天际线。
landmarks.description_en: Paris’s best-known landmark, rising above the Seine and the city skyline.
landmarks.imageQuery: Eiffel Tower Champ de Mars Paris

landmarks.name: 自由女神像
landmarks.description: 纽约港的城市象征，可结合轮渡游览。
landmarks.description_en: A symbol of New York Harbor, reached by ferry with views of Manhattan.
landmarks.imageQuery: Statue of Liberty New York Harbor

landmarks.name: 悉尼歌剧院
landmarks.description: 海港边的建筑地标，日落时分体验最佳。
landmarks.description_en: A landmark of modern architecture on Sydney Harbour, especially striking at sunset.

landmarks.name: 鱼尾狮公园
landmarks.description: 滨海湾城市景观与美食步行的起点。
landmarks.description_en: A waterfront icon and convenient starting point for a Marina Bay walk.

landmarks.name: 故宫
landmarks.description: 中国明清皇家宫殿建筑群，适合历史文化与建筑摄影。
landmarks.description_en: China’s vast Ming and Qing imperial palace complex, rich in history and architectural detail.

landmarks.name: 东方明珠
landmarks.description: 浦东天际线代表地标，可俯瞰黄浦江与外滩。
landmarks.description_en: A defining tower of Shanghai’s Pudong skyline with broad views across the Huangpu River.

landmarks.name: 西湖
landmarks.description: 湖山与古迹相融的世界文化遗产，适合步行和骑行。
landmarks.description_en: A World Heritage cultural landscape where gardens, causeways and historic sites meet the lake.

landmarks.name: 张家界国家森林公园
landmarks.description: 石英砂岩峰林景观，云雾天气尤其适合风光摄影。
landmarks.description_en: A national forest park known for dramatic quartz-sandstone pillars, mist and mountain trails.

landmarks.name: 洱海
landmarks.description: 苍山脚下的高原湖泊，环湖骑行、日出和村落摄影体验丰富。
landmarks.description_en: A highland lake below the Cangshan Mountains, popular for cycling, villages and sunrise views.

landmarks.name: 东京塔
landmarks.description: 东京经典城市地标，傍晚至夜间适合天际线摄影。
landmarks.description_en: A classic Tokyo landmark and observation tower with vivid evening city views.

landmarks.name: 景福宫
landmarks.description: 首尔中心的朝鲜王朝宫殿，可结合北村与传统服饰体验。
landmarks.description_en: The principal palace of the Joseon dynasty, close to Bukchon and traditional neighborhoods.

landmarks.name: 大皇宫
landmarks.description: 曼谷代表性宫殿与寺庙建筑群，建议清晨到访并注意着装。
landmarks.description_en: Bangkok’s ornate royal and temple complex, best visited early with respectful dress.

landmarks.name: 下龙湾
landmarks.description: 海上喀斯特地貌世界遗产，适合乘船与海湾摄影。
landmarks.description_en: A World Heritage seascape of limestone towers, islands and sheltered bays.

landmarks.name: 婆罗浮屠
landmarks.description: 大型佛教遗址，以清晨火山背景与石刻闻名。
landmarks.description_en: A monumental Buddhist sanctuary famed for carved stone terraces and volcanic scenery.

landmarks.name: 泰姬陵
landmarks.description: 白色大理石陵墓建筑，日出时光线柔和、游客较少。
landmarks.description_en: A white-marble mausoleum celebrated for its symmetry, craftsmanship and soft sunrise light.

landmarks.name: 哈利法塔
landmarks.description: 全球知名摩天建筑，可俯瞰迪拜城市与沙漠边缘。
landmarks.description_en: The world-famous skyscraper offering panoramic views of Dubai and the desert edge.

landmarks.name: 卢浮宫
landmarks.description: 世界级艺术博物馆，馆藏丰富，建议提前选择重点展区。
landmarks.description_en: One of the world’s great art museums, housed in a former royal palace in central Paris.

landmarks.name: 罗马斗兽场
landmarks.description: 古罗马文明代表遗址，可与古罗马广场安排同日步行。
landmarks.description_en: Ancient Rome’s monumental amphitheatre, easily combined with the Roman Forum on foot.

landmarks.name: 大本钟
landmarks.description: 威斯敏斯特宫钟楼，泰晤士河两岸有多处经典拍摄机位。
landmarks.description_en: The clock tower of the Palace of Westminster and a defining feature of London’s riverfront.

landmarks.name: 圣家堂
landmarks.description: 高迪未完杰作，以独特立面和彩色光影闻名。
landmarks.description_en: Gaudí’s evolving basilica, known for sculpted façades and colorful interior light.

landmarks.name: 雅典卫城
landmarks.description: 古希腊建筑遗址群，日落前后可俯瞰雅典。
landmarks.description_en: A hilltop complex of classical Greek monuments overlooking the city of Athens.

landmarks.name: 圣索菲亚大教堂
landmarks.description: 横跨多种文明历史的穹顶建筑，与蓝色清真寺相邻。
landmarks.description_en: A monumental domed building whose architecture reflects centuries of Byzantine and Ottoman history.

landmarks.name: 金门大桥
landmarks.description: 跨越金门海峡的红色悬索桥，多处观景台适合城市摄影。
landmarks.description_en: San Francisco’s red suspension bridge, viewed from coastal trails and bay overlooks.

landmarks.name: 大峡谷
landmarks.description: 科罗拉多河切割形成的巨大峡谷，日出日落层次鲜明。
landmarks.description_en: A vast canyon carved by the Colorado River, with layered views at sunrise and sunset.

landmarks.name: 尼亚加拉瀑布
landmarks.description: 跨越加拿大与美国边界的大型瀑布群，可乘船近距离体验。
landmarks.description_en: A powerful group of waterfalls on the Canada–United States border, seen from viewpoints and boats.

landmarks.name: 奇琴伊察
landmarks.description: 玛雅文明重要遗址，以库库尔坎金字塔闻名。
landmarks.description_en: A major Maya archaeological site centered on the stepped pyramid of El Castillo.

landmarks.name: 基督山
landmarks.description: 科尔科瓦多山顶城市地标，可俯瞰里约海湾与城区。
landmarks.description_en: Rio’s Art Deco statue on Corcovado Mountain, overlooking the city, beaches and bay.

landmarks.name: 马丘比丘
landmarks.description: 安第斯山中的印加古城，需提前规划交通和入场时段。
landmarks.description_en: An Inca citadel set high in the Andes, reached through cloud forest and mountain scenery.

landmarks.name: 吉萨金字塔
landmarks.description: 古埃及代表性建筑群，清晨和傍晚气温更适合游览。
landmarks.description_en: The monumental pyramid complex of ancient Giza, including the Great Pyramid and the Sphinx.

landmarks.name: 桌山
landmarks.description: 俯瞰开普敦与大西洋的平顶山，可徒步或乘缆车。
landmarks.description_en: Cape Town’s flat-topped mountain, reached by cableway or hiking trails for coastal views.

landmarks.name: 大堡礁
landmarks.description: 世界最大的珊瑚礁生态系统，可通过持牌运营商参加浮潜体验。
landmarks.description_en: The world’s largest coral reef system, explored through licensed snorkeling and diving trips.

landmarks.name: 米尔福德峡湾
landmarks.description: 冰川塑造的峡湾与瀑布景观，阴雨天也具有独特氛围。
landmarks.description_en: A glacier-carved fiord of steep peaks and waterfalls, atmospheric even in rainy weather.

landmarks.name: 红场
landmarks.description: 莫斯科历史核心，可步行串联克里姆林宫与圣瓦西里大教堂。
landmarks.stay: 特维尔区或阿尔巴特街
landmarks.transport: 地铁猎人商行站步行抵达
landmarks.description_en: Moscow’s historic center, linking the Kremlin, Saint Basil’s Cathedral and GUM.
landmarks.transport_en: Walk from Okhotny Ryad metro station

landmarks.name: 冬宫博物馆
landmarks.description: 收藏横跨欧洲艺术史的宫殿博物馆，建议提前选定重点展厅。
landmarks.transport: 地铁海军部站步行约10分钟
landmarks.description_en: A palace museum with collections spanning European art, archaeology and imperial history.
landmarks.transport_en: About a 10-minute walk from Admiralteyskaya metro station
landmarks.imageQuery: State Hermitage Museum Winter Palace exterior

landmarks.name: 贝加尔湖
landmarks.description: 世界最深淡水湖，冬季蓝冰与夏季湖岸徒步各有特色。
landmarks.transport: 从伊尔库茨克乘正规巴士或包车
landmarks.description_en: The world’s deepest freshwater lake, known for winter ice and summer shoreline landscapes.
landmarks.bestSeason_en: February to March or July to August
landmarks.transport_en: Licensed bus or transfer from Irkutsk

landmarks.name: 伊瓜苏瀑布
landmarks.description: 跨越巴西与阿根廷边境的巨型瀑布群，巴西侧适合全景观赏。
landmarks.transport: 机场或市区巴士前往国家公园
landmarks.description_en: A vast waterfall system shared by Brazil and Argentina, with sweeping views from the Brazilian side.
landmarks.transport_en: Park bus from the airport or city

landmarks.name: 佩洛里尼奥历史中心
landmarks.description: 色彩鲜明的殖民建筑与非裔巴西文化共同构成的世界遗产街区。
landmarks.transport: 打车至历史中心后步行
landmarks.description_en: A colorful colonial quarter where architecture, music and Afro-Brazilian culture meet.
landmarks.transport_en: Taxi to the historic center, then walk

landmarks.name: 杰马夫纳广场
landmarks.description: 从日间市集到夜间食摊不断变换的老城公共空间。
landmarks.transport: 老城外围下车后步行
landmarks.description_en: Marrakesh’s central square, changing from daytime market to evening food and performance hub.
landmarks.bestSeason_en: March to May and September to November
landmarks.stay_en: A licensed riad in the Medina
landmarks.transport_en: Get off outside the Medina and continue on foot

landmarks.name: 马赛马拉国家保护区
landmarks.description: 东非代表性草原生态区，以大型野生动物与季节性迁徙闻名。
landmarks.transport: 内罗毕小型飞机或正规越野车
landmarks.description_en: A renowned East African grassland reserve known for wildlife and seasonal migration.
landmarks.transport_en: Light aircraft or licensed 4x4 from Nairobi

landmarks.name: 塞伦盖蒂国家公园
landmarks.description: 广阔草原与迁徙兽群构成东非最具代表性的自然景观。
landmarks.transport: 从阿鲁沙参加正规向导行程
landmarks.description_en: An immense savanna ecosystem famous for wildlife, open horizons and the great migration.
landmarks.transport_en: Guided trip from Arusha

landmarks.name: 严岛神社
landmarks.description: 随潮汐呈现不同景观的海上神社，适合与宫岛步行同游。
landmarks.transport: JR至宫岛口后乘轮渡
landmarks.description_en: A seaside Shinto shrine whose famous gate changes character with the tides.
landmarks.transport_en: JR to Miyajimaguchi, then ferry

landmarks.name: 吴哥窟
landmarks.description: 吴哥王朝大型寺庙群，日出后按小圈或大圈分日游览更从容。
landmarks.transport: 持票乘突突车或包车
landmarks.description_en: The monumental temple complex of the Khmer Empire, best explored over several days.
landmarks.stay_en: Old Market or riverside Siem Reap
landmarks.transport_en: Licensed tuk-tuk or car with a valid temple pass

landmarks.name: 双子塔
landmarks.description: 吉隆坡天际线核心地标，公园与观景层提供不同视角。
landmarks.transport: 轻轨KLCC站
landmarks.description_en: Twin skyscrapers at the heart of Kuala Lumpur, paired with a park and observation deck.
landmarks.transport_en: LRT to KLCC station

landmarks.name: 珠峰地区
landmarks.description: 喜马拉雅高山徒步核心区域，必须预留适应海拔与天气机动时间。
landmarks.transport: 从加德满都飞卢卡拉并由向导带领
landmarks.description_en: The core Himalayan trekking region, requiring careful acclimatization and weather planning.
landmarks.bestSeason_en: March to May and October to November
landmarks.transport_en: Fly from Kathmandu to Lukla and continue with a guide

landmarks.name: 佩特拉古城
landmarks.description: 沿蛇道进入玫瑰色岩石古城，卡兹尼神殿只是庞大遗址的一部分。
landmarks.stay: 瓦迪穆萨游客中心附近
landmarks.transport: 安曼或亚喀巴乘正规巴士
landmarks.description_en: An extensive rose-colored rock city entered through the Siq, with trails beyond the Treasury.
landmarks.bestSeason_en: March to May and September to November
landmarks.stay_en: Near the visitor center in Wadi Musa
landmarks.transport_en: Licensed bus from Amman or Aqaba

landmarks.name: 新天鹅堡
landmarks.description: 阿尔卑斯山麓的浪漫主义城堡，玛丽安桥是经典远眺点。
landmarks.transport: 慕尼黑火车至菲森后换公交
landmarks.description_en: A Romantic-era castle below the Alps, with classic views from Marienbrücke.
landmarks.transport_en: Train from Munich to Füssen, then local bus

landmarks.name: 贝伦塔
landmarks.description: 特茹河畔航海时代防御塔，可与热罗尼莫斯修道院同游。
landmarks.transport: 15E有轨电车或火车至贝伦
landmarks.description_en: A riverside defensive tower associated with Portugal’s Age of Discovery.
landmarks.transport_en: Tram 15E or train to Belém

landmarks.name: 黄金圈
landmarks.description: 串联辛格韦德利、盖歇尔与黄金瀑布的经典地热与地质路线。
landmarks.transport: 正规一日团或冬季适配车辆
landmarks.description_en: A classic route linking Thingvellir, Geysir and Gullfoss through Icelandic geology.
landmarks.transport_en: Licensed day tour or winter-ready vehicle

landmarks.name: 班夫国家公园
landmarks.description: 落基山湖泊、冰川与森林组成的国家公园，适合公路与轻徒步。
landmarks.transport: 卡尔加里租车或接驳巴士
landmarks.description_en: A Rocky Mountain national park of lakes, glaciers and forests suited to road trips and hiking.
landmarks.transport_en: Rental car or shuttle from Calgary

landmarks.name: 莫雷诺冰川
landmarks.description: 可从栈道近距离观察冰川裂隙与崩落，也是巴塔哥尼亚代表景观。
landmarks.transport: 参加国家公园巴士或持牌一日团
landmarks.description_en: A dramatic Patagonian glacier viewed from extensive boardwalks and licensed excursions.
landmarks.transport_en: National park bus or licensed day tour

landmarks.name: 百内国家公园
landmarks.description: 花岗岩峰、冰川湖与草原构成巴塔哥尼亚最经典的徒步景观。
landmarks.stay: 园区营地或纳塔莱斯港
landmarks.transport: 纳塔莱斯港巴士进入园区
landmarks.description_en: A Patagonian park of granite towers, glacial lakes and celebrated multi-day trails.
landmarks.transport_en: Park bus from Puerto Natales
landmarks.imageQuery: Torres del Paine National Park Puerto Natales

landmarks.name: 霍比屯电影外景地
landmarks.description: 保留完整布景的田园电影外景地，必须跟随官方导览进入。
landmarks.transport: 奥克兰或罗托鲁瓦接驳巴士
landmarks.description_en: A preserved countryside film set visited on guided tours through the Shire landscape.
landmarks.transport_en: Shuttle from Auckland or Rotorua

landmarks.name: 莫斯科克里姆林宫
landmarks.description: 俄罗斯国家历史与建筑核心，宫殿、教堂和城墙共同构成莫斯科最重要的文化地标。
landmarks.description_en: Russia’s historic and architectural center, bringing together palaces, cathedrals and fortified walls.
landmarks.stay: 特维尔区或阿尔巴特街
landmarks.transport: 地铁亚历山大花园站步行抵达
landmarks.transport_en: Walk from Aleksandrovsky Sad metro station

landmarks.name: 圣瓦西里大教堂
landmarks.description: 红场南端色彩鲜明的洋葱顶教堂，是俄罗斯建筑最具辨识度的象征之一。
landmarks.description_en: The colorful onion-domed cathedral at the southern end of Red Square is one of Russia’s most recognizable buildings.
landmarks.transport: 地铁中国城站或革命广场站步行
landmarks.transport_en: Walk from Kitay-gorod or Ploshchad Revolyutsii metro station

landmarks.name: 彼得霍夫宫
landmarks.description: 芬兰湾畔的皇家宫殿与喷泉园林，以大瀑布和夏季水景闻名。
landmarks.description_en: An imperial palace and fountain garden on the Gulf of Finland, famous for the Grand Cascade.
landmarks.transport: 市区水翼船或正规巴士
landmarks.transport_en: Hydrofoil or licensed bus from central Saint Petersburg

landmarks.name: 喀山克里姆林宫
landmarks.description: 东正教建筑与库尔·谢里夫清真寺并存的世界遗产，展现鞑靼与俄罗斯文化交汇。
landmarks.description_en: A World Heritage citadel where Orthodox architecture and the Qol Sharif Mosque reflect Tatar and Russian culture.
landmarks.transport: 喀山市中心步行或地铁至克里姆林站
landmarks.transport_en: Walk from central Kazan or use Kremlyovskaya metro station

landmarks.name: 基日岛木结构教堂群
landmarks.description: 奥涅加湖岛上的世界遗产木建筑群，以无钉建造的多圆顶教堂闻名。
landmarks.description_en: A World Heritage ensemble of wooden churches on Lake Onega, celebrated for its many domes and traditional construction.
landmarks.transport: 从彼得罗扎沃茨克乘官方水翼船
landmarks.transport_en: Official hydrofoil from Petrozavodsk

landmarks.name: 厄尔布鲁士山
landmarks.description: 高加索山脉最高峰，山谷徒步和高海拔登山必须根据经验选择正规向导。
landmarks.description_en: The highest peak in the Caucasus, offering valley hikes and serious high-altitude climbing with qualified guides.
landmarks.transport: 从矿泉城乘正规接驳车进入山谷
landmarks.transport_en: Licensed transfer from Mineralnye Vody

landmarks.name: 堪察加间歇泉谷
landmarks.description: 克罗诺基自然保护区内的大型地热峡谷，只能通过获批的直升机和保护区行程进入。
landmarks.description_en: A major geothermal canyon inside Kronotsky Nature Reserve, accessible only through approved reserve excursions.
landmarks.transport: 参加保护区批准的直升机行程
landmarks.transport_en: Approved reserve helicopter excursion
landmarks.imageQuery: Valley of Geysers Kamchatka Russia photo
